tasks.label: Simulate
tasks.command: iverilog -g2012 -o sim pkt_decoder.v ws_cell.v ws_array.v tb.v && vvp -n sim

tasks.label: Gate count: pkt_decoder
tasks.command: yosys -q -p "read_verilog pkt_decoder.v; synth -top pkt_decoder; tee -o yosys_pkt_decoder.txt stat; tee -a yosys_pkt_decoder.txt ltp -noff" && type yosys_pkt_decoder.txt

tasks.label: Gate count: ws_cell
tasks.command: yosys -q -p "read_verilog -sv ws_cell.v; synth -top ws_cell; tee -o yosys_ws_cell.txt stat; tee -a yosys_ws_cell.txt ltp -noff" && type yosys_ws_cell.txt

tasks.label: Gate count: ws_array (64 neurons, slow)
tasks.command: yosys -q -p "read_verilog -sv pkt_decoder.v ws_cell.v ws_array.v; synth -flatten -top ws_array; tee -o yosys_ws_array.txt stat" && type yosys_ws_array.txt
